name: Turn guidance, live-source validity and on-road speed warnings
reason: One UK junction approach can verify the navigation card, timed source/warning state and legal speed/signal interpretation with one test build and common evidence.
test_mode: test definitions/expected results public; execute against actual private app in private GitHub Actions; never upload private app source, TomTom key or APK

independent_sources.publisher: Department for Transport / GOV.UK Highway Code
independent_sources.applies_to: junction lane/sign precedence; turn instructions must not override verified road signs
independent_sources.meaning: guidance, specific location truth separately verified

independent_sources.publisher: Department for Transport Know your traffic signs
independent_sources.applies_to: combined direction arrows and compulsory lane markings; never invent continuous lane groups

independent_sources.publisher: Department for Transport Know your traffic signs
independent_sources.applies_to: mandatory and prohibited instructions take precedence over generic navigation wording

independent_sources.publisher: Department for Transport / GOV.UK Highway Code
independent_sources.applies_to: road-speed limit is a legal maximum; no speed advisory above active verified sign limit
independent_sources.meaning: statutory road-speed limit rule and guidance

source_rule: Independent expected answers derive from current official highway rules, posted signs/orders and source-timed data. App code under test cannot certify a real UK road's signs, legal speed or lane arrangements.

items.acceptance: User compact card: large arrow left, distance and road/sign right; presentation preference, not law
Show distance between junctions and large turn arrow at approach
Clear lane wording; do not invent lane connectivity, bound to actual verified signs
Live route calculations require genuinely timely comparable provider data
User-entered key is stored privately; no public key or separate unauthorized network call
Official verified road information outranks unverified driver report; distinguish stale/unavailable
Announce grouped bumps once in Full sound mode
Compare verified active legal limit with recent actual measured speed
Repeat speeding audio once a minute per setting
Show verified lower-limit sign exactly at change point
Extra warning when approaching while speeding
Average speed and limit zone display
Variable/temporary speed limits only when officially confirmed active

test_boundary: Logic assertions and static code inspections are baseline diagnostic only. Real junction truth and UI visual/audio/Android Auto robot acceptance remain separate; no category completion or APK release from this suite alone.
current_reference_status: Independent official guidance URLs recorded; actual local junction sign/traffic orders and active temporary limits not yet obtained.
